speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I see you're presenting with agitation and a yellowish tint to your skin and eyes; can you tell me when these symptoms first started? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urine or stool color recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Given your history of high-risk sexual behavior and recent agitation, have you experienced any fever, nausea, or right upper quadrant abdominal pain?

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you recall any recent exposure to contaminated needles or sharing drug paraphernalia with others? Also, have you noticed any darkening of your urine or pale, clay-colored stools?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Occasional use of cocaine and ecstasy. Social alcohol consumption (about 20 g on weekends).

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you recall any recent episodes of severe abdominal pain, or have you noticed your urine turning dark and your stools becoming pale? Also, have you had any recent surgeries or blood transfusions? REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Panel and Hepatitis Serology.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver Function Panel: Bilirubin 25 mg/dL (elevated), AST 600 IU/L (elevated), ALT 650 IU/L (elevated), TP Activity < 40% (reduced), INR 1.5 (elevated). Hepatitis Serology: Not available in current data.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis Serology and Acetaminophen Level. Given your severe liver enzyme elevation and coagulopathy, have you taken any over-the-counter pain relievers like acetaminophen or any herbal supplements recently?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hepatitis Serology: Not available in current data. Acetaminophen Level: Not available in current data.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your severe liver dysfunction and high-risk behaviors, have you had any recent unprotected sexual encounters or shared needles that could expose you to Hepatitis B or C? REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis B Surface Antigen and Hepatitis C Antibody.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the Hepatitis serology results are normal, have you experienced any recent fever, fatigue, or right upper quadrant pain that might suggest acute viral hepatitis despite the negative initial screen, or could your symptoms be related to drug-induced liver injury? REQUEST TEST: Coagulation Profile and Drug Screen.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Coagulation Profile: INR 1.5 (elevated). Drug Screen: Not available in current data.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your young age, agitation, and severe acute liver failure with negative hepatitis serology, have you taken any recreational drugs like ecstasy (MDMA) or cocaine in the past week, which can cause severe hepatotoxicity? REQUEST TEST: Acetaminophen Level and Toxicology Screen.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Acetaminophen Level: Not available in current data. Toxicology Screen: Not available in current data.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Liver Failure likely secondary to Acetaminophen Toxicity or Drug-Induced Liver Injury from recreational substances (MDMA/Cocaine), given the severe transaminitis, coagulopathy, jaundice, and agitation in the context of high-risk drug use and negative initial viral hepatitis screening.
